ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio featuring dominant high-intensity white regions on the lateral lobes and low-intensity black pigmentation concentrated around the median notch and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white fields occupy the distal portions of both lobes. A high-contrast black geometric block originates at the median notch and extends outwards, creating a wedge-like shape with stippled/mottled transition zones at the pigmentation borders.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge; irregular peaks and valleys isolated against the grey-white water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broad convex curves sweeping from the distal tips toward the central notch region.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, dark-ringed scar clusters (barnacle attachment sites) visible on the white field of the right lobe; dense clusters of calcified barnacles are present on the far lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent, near-vertical dark linear disruption on the right lobe; several thinner, faint linear marks visible on the lower section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the fluke tips; distinct vertical rake mark/scratch on the right lobe; multiple circular healed lesions on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A small, distinct yellowish-brown circular focal spot located near the center of the right lobe's white field.
